'''P. Dantari''' was a member of the [[Liana Liberators]]. [[Gender/Legends|His]] ''P. Dantari'' name was an alias used as part of the Liberator's attempt to pose as members of the [[Alderaanian Biological Research Institute]] when they came to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He contacted the ''[[Starchaser IV]]'' when the Liberators were attacked by [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] It is unknown what his real identity was.
